feedback: The confession follows the strongest pre-vote contradiction: Cary's spare-glass claim attempts to sever the laboratory result from the glass Grant actually used. It confirms the preview theft and later contamination, actions already supported by his admitted stopper opening and private-room visit. Those are admissions of the inferred act rather than a newly introduced mechanism. The final line about never being asked to move anything again suits his practical voice and makes the loss personal without excusing him. Elle's repayment problem and Chip's false insurance date also resolve their competing suspicious behavior. The explanation feels earned, although Cary's prior knowledge of the contents remains less explicit than his access and false glass account.
